name: SoCal Please Be Qualified 2023

venue.name: UC San Diego Rady School of Management
venue.details: Otterson Hall Multipurpose Room 2 (Room 2S117 on the 2nd floor)

information: # This is a [PBQ Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoCalPBQ2023#29026-what-is-a-pbq-competition), without regular 3x3x3. Please consider [Westview Favorites 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewCubingFavorites2023) for a competition with 3x3x3. The competition will take place at UC San Diego's Rady School of Management, in Otterson Hall's Multipurpose Room 2 (Room 2S117 on the second floor). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoCalPleaseBeQualified2023#29064-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)
